_about: Optional visual skins. Each skin: id, name, price (Bounty Dollars), optional shader and optional asset overrides.
shader: a res:// path to a canvas_item shader drawn over the whole finished screen; it reads the screen with `uniform sampler2D screen_texture : hint_screen_texture;`. null means none.

overrides: manifest names mapped to replacement art, either a file path under res://assets/ or an entry like those in assets/manifest.json. Anything not overridden, or whose file is missing, shows the standard art.
Skins change pictures only. Hitboxes, cover sizes and every other gameplay number come from data/geometry.json and levels.json and are never read from art.
